systems.intent_read: This is a narrow housekeeping patch: one item (Radiant Regeneration) and three hero kits (Baba, Deadman Danny, Street Brawl) were touched, with nothing at the economy, objective, movement or map layer. Valve is not trying to move the meta here — the templated Tough Crate/Sunken Plaza/Bell Tower income engine and the no-comeback valve stand as the KB thesis describes, so any meta movement must come from the item and hero changes alone.

items.summary: Third cumulative trim to the regen-sustain shell (heal-on-cast 08-22, per-boon 09-16, spirit scaling 0.04->0.035 now). At 94-98% buy on its holders it won't drop out of builds, but spirit-scaling means each point of spirit power buys less healing, so spirit-stacking users feel it more than gun-hybrid ones.

synthesis.size_why: One item trim (Radiant Regeneration) plus one major hero cut (Baba) and one buff package (Deadman Danny) — no economy, objective, movement, map or comeback lever moved, so the way games are won is untouched. The 'General 27' count is breadth of tuning, not structural depth.
synthesis.headline: Baba's unkillable frontline got gutted and Deadman Danny got a real buff package, but the Tough Crate/Sunken Plaza/Bell Tower income engine still decides games exactly as before.

meta_thesis.previous: Games are won by templated PvE map income — guaranteed Tough Crate routes, Sunken Plaza (5-8m) and Bell Tower (8m+) hub fights — with no comeback valve, so AoE/sustain camp-clearers and heavy-melee box farmers bank faster than lane bullies.
meta_thesis.new: Unchanged: the economy, objective bounties, respawn tax and no-comeback valve all carry over, so the farm-route-then-forced-hub-fight shape stands; the patch only reshuffles which sustain frontline holds the archetype slot, cutting Baba out of it and handing Deadman Danny a sharper (but still flyer-taxed) kit.
meta_thesis.why: No systems, economy, map or item-slot change — the drivers are a third cumulative Radiant Regeneration trim and a Baba kit cut, which move heroes inside existing archetypes rather than moving the archetypes themselves.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The patch's real winner set is 'anyone who fought Baba' — Apollo, Calico and Solomon all move up while untouched.
non_obvious_calls.why: All three list Baba as their worst or near-worst matchup, and her cut hits barrier, bullet resist and mobility simultaneously.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Radiant Regeneration's third consecutive trim is a stealth buff to anti-heal and burst, not a sustain-item change.
non_obvious_calls.why: No competing sustain item was added, so Healbane/Decay and pre-ramp burst get relatively better while the regen archetype erodes file-by-file.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Deadman Danny's buff package does not lift him out of C-tier despite the numbers.
non_obvious_calls.why: He is still a flyer in an anti-air, high-air-drag environment where Silver's Bola is the answer — the direct buffs fight a context that was not changed.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Baba's cut is framed as hero tuning but targets the front-line dive slot only T3-bullet-resist picks can hold.
non_obvious_calls.why: -7% Base Bullet Resist plus the barrier gutting attacks exactly the commit-to-dive role the KB says is reserved for Apollo/Mo & Krill.

uncertainties: Whether Baba's -7% bullet resist plus barrier cut is survivable enough to keep her a frontline pick or drops her out of the archetype entirely.

what_to_watch: Baba's WR and pick rate post-nerf — does the frontline slot go to Mo & Krill/Billy outright?
Radiant Regeneration buy rate on Lady Geist, Shiv, Celeste and Baba — does the third trim finally drop it below core?
Deadman Danny WR — does the buff package translate past the anti-air environment?
Healbane/Decay buy rate as regen erodes — the tell that anti-heal is the new sustain answer.
Any hotfix that adds a sustain item or touches the Tough Crate/Bell Tower economy, which would break the continuation thesis.
